items.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
items.summary: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.

items.title: From the front row to the hot seat — what the midterms mean for Big Tech

items.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
items.summary: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
items.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.

items.title: The Duo apps are coming, says Apple
items.summary: There are now 100,000 Duo-optimized apps, says Apple, and thousands more arrive daily.

items.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
items.summary: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.

items.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
items.summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.

items.summary: Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the...

items.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
items.summary: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to help 6K scale up its microwave-plasma battery material manufacturing process.

items.title: Fox completes its $22B acquisition of Roku
items.summary: A few months after DOJ investigators were probing the deal, Fox just completed its $22B acquisition of the streaming giant Roku.

items.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
items.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

items.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
items.summary: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

items.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
items.summary: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

items.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
items.summary: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

items.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
items.summary: The decision to wind down the EV comes after just a few short years of underwhelming sales. Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.

items.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
items.summary: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
items.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

items.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
items.summary: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

items.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
items.summary: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.

items.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
